subject: Proposal: interim surge buffer & staggered credits for midcycle expansion
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: interim surge buffer proposal for CloudWave (CLWD-9843)

Ben / Priyom —

I pulled together a short set of options for CloudWave's midcycle expansion request. Key context: they expect a 3x spike for 6–10 weeks starting in Oct and want minimal upfront commitment. The account team is pushing for a solution that preserves ARR but doesn't force them into a full uplift.

Options (short):
- Option A (Conservative): 50% surge bucket for 6 months, 25% carryforward into next quarter, standard renewal pricing.
- Option B (Balanced): 75% surge bucket for 9 months, 50% carryforward, 10% one-time onboarding credit.
- Option C (Aggressive): Full requested capacity, pro-rated invoice, 15% volume discount for first 3 months, no carryforward.

Revenue impact: A ~low/neutral, B ~moderate upside, C short-term hit but locks capacity. Ops/fulfillment constraints: we need a 2-week lead for GPU pool scaling unless we allow burst to hosted.

Attached: proposal-draft.pdf (high-level table + example invoices).

Can you both review ASAP? If we agree, I'll send to Natalie with a clear recommended path.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0183
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Ramos <natalie@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: interim surge buffer & staggered credits (CLWD-9843)

Hi Natalie —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a short proposal with one recommended path (Option B) and two alternatives. High-level summary below so you can share with your finance and ops teams quickly.

Recommended (Option B):
- 75% interim surge buffer to cover forecasted spike (9 months).
- 50% of unused surge capacity carryforward to the following quarter for up to 6 months.
- 10% one-time onboarding credit to offset migration/engineering costs.
- Pricing bands: baseline rate stays the same; surge units billed at a blended 85% of baseline for first 3 months, reverting to baseline thereafter.

Why this helps you:
- Reduces upfront commitment while giving headroom for peaks.
- Preserves monthly predictability with carryforward for unused surges.
- Lower near-term unit price for the heavy-usage months.

Next steps:
1) Let me know if finance wants monthly invoicing vs. billable quarterly.
2) If the terms look good, we can issue a final pricing addendum and a DocuSign for signature.
3) Ops: we need a two-week notice to provision dedicated capacity; hosted burst is faster but has higher unit cost.

Attachments: CloudWave_PRICING_1.1.pdf (proposal table + sample invoices)

Would you be available for a 30-minute call Thursday to finalize?

Best,
Marissa
From: Natalie Ramos <natalie@cloudwave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: interim surge buffer & staggered credits (CLWD-9843)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear options. Our finance team reviewed and asked for two changes before we can move forward:

1) Reduce the upfront commitment to a 30% surge buffer (instead of 75%) but allow a stronger carryforward (up to 75% of unused surge) for the next two quarters.
2) Can we get a monthly invoicing cadence and an explicit cap on total spend for the first 90 days?

Operationally, engineering prefers a smaller immediate allocation — they can handle burst from hosted for the short term. We’ll attach our usage forecast so you can see the expected ramp (attached: CloudWave-usage-projection.xlsx).

If you can model their request quickly and share a one-pager with final numbers, we’ll escalate to our CFO for signoff.

Best,
Natalie Ramos
Head of Platform Ops, CloudWave
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CloudWave asks — recommended concession and ops checklist

Ben / Priyom —

Natalie pushed back to a 30% buffer request plus higher carryforward and monthly invoicing. My recommended counter to balance revenue and flexibility:

- Final offer (recommended):
  • 50% interim surge buffer for 6 months (compromise).
  • Carryforward: up to 60% of unused surge usable over next two quarters.
  • Monthly invoicing for the first 90 days (then quarterly unless they opt-in).
  • 7% blended discount on surge units for the first 60 days; then blended 90% baseline rate.
  • Total spend cap option: if they want an explicit cap, we can add a soft cap with automated alerts and a manual approval flow.

Impacts:
- Revenue: preserves ~80% of expected uplift vs. their ask for a much lower commitment; small near-term discount but avoids full ARR loss.
- Legal/Finance: we need a short addendum (1–2 pages) with carryforward rules and invoicing cadence; Priyom, can finance accept monthly invoices for the trial period and standardize the carryforward accounting treatment?
- Ops: provisioning note — we can do hosted burst to cover immediate spikes while we stage dedicated capacity (2-week lead).

Attachments: signature_matrix.xlsx (shows approval chain & signer emails).

If you both approve, I’ll send the counter to Natalie tonight with a one-pager and the updated pricing PDF.

—Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Ramos <natalie@cloudwave.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: interim surge buffer package for CloudWave (final terms)

Hi Natalie —

Thanks for the patience while we modeled the ask. We’ve agreed internally to the package below and can move to signature:

Final terms (CLWD-9843):
- Interim surge buffer: 50% of requested capacity for 6 months (starts on activation date).
- Carryforward: up to 60% of unused surge, valid across next two quarters.
- Invoicing: monthly for first 90 days; will default to quarterly after unless CloudWave requests otherwise.
- Pricing: 7% blended discount on surge units for the first 60 days, blended 90% baseline rate for subsequent surge billing.
- Total spend cap: optional; we can include a soft cap with automatic alerts — if you’d like a hard cap we’ll need a short amendment with prepayment.

Attached is the updated pricing addendum (CloudWave_PRICING_1.2.pdf) and a DocuSign link for signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123

If this looks good, please sign and we’ll coordinate provisioning and invoicing.

Looking forward to helping CloudWave scale without surprises.

Best,
Ben Carter
Principal Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
